HomePage.WelcomeMessage: Hello! Welcome to my little portfolio corner!

AboutPage.Message1: But if you prefer, my name is Gabriel.
AboutPage.Message2: My pronouns are he/him or they/them, I don't really mind she/her pronouns.
AboutPage.Message3: Just whatever pronouns you say and I understand you're talking to me.
AboutPage.Message4: I don't really wanna make a fuss about it.

WorkExperience.Message0: I've been working with Angular for about over 2 years
WorkExperience.Message1: First I've started with Deloitte during my college mandatory traineeship.
WorkExperience.Message2: It was pretty much a fullstack project, where each student was supposed to learn a bit about the web building process, and then decide what they'd like to focus on.
WorkExperience.Message3: So after the traineeship, I've decided to go into Frontend. And because we've used Angular, I stuck with it until now.
WorkExperience.Message4: I was then hired in Comarch, where I got to experience working on a large project with many talented people.
WorkExperience.Message5: It was a very different experience compared to before, mostly because it was my first time in an actual company project.
WorkExperience.Message6: But I worked on some of the projects features, on some bugfixing, even developing some more interesting functionalities.
WorkExperience.Message7: Things like biometric authentication on a native mobile version of the app, or creating an interactive world map.
